image_description: A side-profile view of a turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, walking on dry ground covered with leaf litter and twigs. The turtle has a high-domed, smooth, greyish-brown carapace. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small lateral eye. The skin appears rough and scaly. One front limb is visible, appearing stout. The background consists of out-of-focus vegetation and soil.

The tail is located at the posterior end and is occluded by the angle of the shell and the ground/vegetation behind it. It cannot be seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral/functional trait that cannot be verified from a static image unless the turtle is attempting to retract. The current pose (walking) does not test this capability.
